title: Transport: four voices, crosstalk and nods
note: Diarization under stress: heavy onset lag and flicker, crosstalk, nods from three listeners. A one-word answer that is a turn, nods that are not. No diversions.

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: Panel, tonight's question is about transport. Should the new rail line go ahead?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, absolutely. It will cut journey times in half and bring jobs to the north.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: And the cost has already come down to 40 billion.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: But 40 billion could build a lot of hospitals.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hospitals come out of a separate budget.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: Can I just say, I live on the route, and nobody asked us.

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: Panelist B, should it go ahead?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, it should, but only if the cost is capped at 40 billion.

turns.speaker: C
turns.text: And what about the people who will lose their homes?

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: We'll come to that. Hepta, any patterns so far?
